quote.text: LETTERA 29 BISOGNA CONSIGLIARE A TEMPO UTILE Ho intenzione di avvicinarlo e di mostrargli come egli varrebbe di più se valesse di meno nella stima della folla.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Reflect on the importance of timely guidance for your children: offering wise counsel before challenges arise nurtures their growth, much like Seneca’s reminder to advise while the moment is ripe.
    • Encourage humility and self-reflection in your children by showing that true value comes not from the loud praise of others but from measured self-improvement and inner virtue.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, seize the moment to offer honest and constructive advice, reminding colleagues that sometimes a modest view of oneself paves the way to greater achievements and respect.
    • Promote a culture where genuine merit is valued over fleeting public opinion, inspiring your team to pursue excellence by seeking improvement over seeking external approval.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, timing is essential; be proactive in advising your team when the right moment arrives, ensuring that critical feedback fosters innovative progress rather than reactive responses.
    • Help your team understand that sometimes scaling back unnecessary features or lowering inflated expectations can create a truly valuable product, much like embracing modesty can reveal one’s inherent worth.
